body_md:
# Expedition

## Three-Layer Basis and Current Contract

Seoul facts are limited to the approved SP-1.0.0, Decisions 12–15, product authority, and the GAME sources cited in the current chapters below. Existing design-assumption figures are not promoted to implementation values or approved balance. CK3 references are file:line citations in a separate chapter and are not Seoul rules. Product authority: undecided time, alliance, conquest, ownership, and balance policies are institutionally undecided. The details below are preserved, but shared-world/online proxy play should be read within the history-replacement scope of SP-1.0.0.

[Current Basis and Undecided Details](/gdd/rules/game-logic-principles/)

Current product planning gives priority to the detailed SP-1.0.0 singleplayer contract. It uses one player, one main body, NPCs, and a single campaign save, and the provisions in this document on a shared world, maximum participants, host, disconnection, occupancy, and online proxies are preserved as history and are not used as current execution premises. The contracts for actual movement, on-site participation, authority, single settlement, and save errors are retained. In case of conflict, follow the superseded scope in the [Singleplayer Detailed Design SP-1.0.0](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/). This does not mean implementation is complete or that existing saves are automatically converted.

This document is the expedition contract for the current product goal. Return is one of five endings, not a forced return. It is not implemented yet.

You set out from the base. That does not mean you must come back.

The same departure splits into five.

1. **Return.** Close out the commission and stamp it in the base ledger.
2. **Settle.** You may stay at the station where you set out. The faction that holds the land seats a new head over an abandoned base: a Stationmaster in the Government, a Station Foreman in the Free Cities, a Bench Keeper in the Arc (01-core §8) (provisional T21-rules-a-8).
3. **Conquer.** Push stations and exits outward from where you stand. This is conquest in the 4X sense. Armies do not cross the river, so across it you push only over the bridges and through the under-river tunnels (01-core §7.4).
4. **Wander.** Buy your way along the lines without a base. Drifting is also an expedition.
5. **Trade.** Hand goods over at a distance and leave your name in another ledger. It may not be a round trip. Payment is counted in the receiving side's reckoning: meals in the Government, kilos and hand-hours in the Free Cities, day-charges and maintenance turns in the Arc (03 §11).

The preparation is the same: people, food, medicine, passage, relationships. You cross segments on the strategic map. When you meet someone, you talk, hide, or engage. After engaging, see [Personal Resolution Battle](/gdd/rules/personal-resolution-battle/). Whether it is combat or a non-combat encounter, the result is recorded in the ledger only once: injuries, time, supplies, reputation, and the station's owner. The expedition may continue after settlement, and return is not another name for saving or applying results.

The scale can grow: from one person to a work crew, a caravan, or a pact among several stations. Even as it grows, choices pass through named hands.

Time runs in slots, hours, days, and weeks. Nearby places are shown in detail and distant ones in aggregate. A campaign turn is one month (09 §3.2); an expedition's slots, hours, days, and weeks are finer time that runs inside that turn (provisional T21-rules-a-1). For the base's daily and weekly tension, see Bases and Territory, Economy and Production, Logistics and Infrastructure, and [Campaign Progression and Crises](/gdd/rules/campaign-progression/).

There is one organised faith, the Arc (bible §1 row 9). People of the Government and the Free Cities have no faith to choose. Arc people get their fitting and charge at the maintenance bench before setting out. No baptism (receiving a new part) happens during an expedition, so a person's part count does not change (provisional T21-rules-a-2). See Faith, Culture, and Knowledge for details.

## Ten Screens and Five Endings

The ten screens in the reference file `GAME-REFERENCE/codex-ux-refs/seoul-screen-flow.html` are one example of the **return branch**. You prepare at the base hub, travel to the destination, pass through the encounter, formation, and combat, confirm the result, and return to the base. That return is the first of the five above. Settling, conquering, wandering, and trading branch off from the same preparation, and “Return to Base” on Screen 10 is not set as a mandatory ending. An expedition without a hub is still an expedition.
body_ko_md:
# 원정

## 삼층 근거와 현행 계약

서울 사실은 승인 SP-1.0.0·결정 12–15·제품 권한과 아래 현행 장이 인용한 GAME 소스에 한정한다. 기존 설계 가정 수치는 구현값이나 승인 밸런스로 승격하지 않는다. CK3 참조는 별도 장의 file:line 근거이며 서울 규칙이 아니다. 제품 권한: 미결정 시간·동맹·정복·소유권·밸런스 정책은 제도 미정이다. 아래 상세는 보존하되 공유 세계/온라인 대행은 SP-1.0.0의 역사 대체 범위로 읽는다.

[현행 근거·미결정 상세](/gdd/rules/game-logic-principles/)

현재 제품 기획은 SP-1.0.0 싱글플레이 상세 계약을 우선한다. 한 플레이어·한 본체·NPC·단일 캠페인 저장을 사용하며 이 문서의 공유 세계·최대 참가자·호스트·접속 종료·점유·온라인 대행 조항은 역사로 보존하고 현재 실행 전제로 사용하지 않는다. 실제 이동·현장 참가·권한·단일 정산·저장 오류 계약은 유지한다. 충돌 시 [싱글플레이 상세 기획 SP-1.0.0](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)의 대체 범위를 따른다. 구현 완료나 기존 저장 자동 변환을 뜻하지 않는다.

이 문서는 현재 제품 목표의 원정 계약이다. 귀환은 다섯 결말 가운데 하나이며, 강제 귀환이 아니다. 구현 완료가 아니다.

거점에서 길을 나선다. 반드시 돌아오라는 뜻이 아니다.

같은 출발이 다섯으로 갈라진다.

1. **귀환.** 의뢰를 닫고 거점 장부에 찍는다.
2. **정착.** 나선 역에 남을 수 있다. 버린 거점에는 그 땅을 쥔 세력이 새 우두머리를 앉힌다. 정부는 역장, 자유도시들은 역반장, 아크는 정비장이다(01-core 8절) (잠정 T21-rules-a-8).
3. **정복.** 선 자리를 기준으로 역과 출입구를 민다. 4X의 정복이다. 강은 군대로 넘지 않으므로 강 건너로는 다리와 강 밑 터널로만 민다(01-core 7.4절).
4. **방랑.** 거점 없이 노선을 산다. 떠돌이도 원정이다.
5. **교역.** 멀리 물건을 넘기고 다른 장부에 이름을 남긴다. 왕복이 아닐 수 있다. 값은 받는 쪽의 셈으로 치른다. 정부는 끼, 자유도시들은 킬로와 손시간, 아크는 하루 충전과 정비 차례다(03장 11절).

준비는 같다. 사람, 식량, 약, 통행, 관계. 전략맵에서 구간을 지난다. 마주치면 말하거나 숨거나 붙는다. 붙은 뒤는 [개인 판정 전투](/gdd/rules/personal-resolution-battle/). 전투든 비전투 조우든 결과는 한 번만 원장에 남는다. 부상, 시간, 물자, 평판, 역의 주인. 정산 뒤에도 원정은 계속될 수 있으며, 귀환은 저장이나 결과 반영의 다른 이름이 아니다.

규모는 커질 수 있다. 한 사람에서 작업반, 상단, 여러 역의 협약. 커져도 선택은 이름 있는 손을 통해 간다.

시간은 칸, 시간, 하루, 한 주다. 가까운 곳은 자세히, 먼 곳은 집계다. 캠페인 턴은 한 달이고(09장 3.2절), 원정의 칸·시간·하루·한 주는 그 턴 안에서 흐르는 세부 시간이다 (잠정 T21-rules-a-1). 거점의 하루와 주의 긴장은 거점과 영토, 경제와 생산, 물류와 기반 시설, [캠페인 진행과 위기](/gdd/rules/campaign-progression/).

조직된 신앙은 아크 하나다(바이블 1절 9행). 정부와 자유도시들의 사람에게는 고를 신앙이 없다. 아크 사람은 나서기 전에 정비대에서 맞춤과 충전을 받아 둔다. 원정 중에는 세례(새 부위 받기)를 하지 않으므로 부위 수가 바뀌지 않는다 (잠정 T21-rules-a-2). 상세는 신앙·문화·지식.

## 열 화면과 다섯 결말

참고 화면 `GAME-REFERENCE/codex-ux-refs/seoul-screen-flow.html`의 열 장은 **귀환 갈래**의 한 예다. 거점 허브에서 준비하고, 목적지로 가고, 조우·진형·전투를 지나, 결과를 확인하고 거점으로 복귀한다. 그 복귀는 위 다섯 가운데 첫째다. 정착·정복·방랑·교역은 같은 준비에서 갈라지며, 화면 10의 「거점으로 복귀」를 필수 엔딩으로 두지 않는다. 허브가 없는 원정도 원정이다.

title: Campaign Progression and Crises
body_md:
# Campaign Progression and Crises

Current product planning gives priority to the detailed SP-1.0.0 singleplayer contract. It uses one player, one main body, NPCs, and a single campaign save, and the provisions in this document on a shared world, maximum participants, host, disconnection, occupancy, and online proxies are preserved as history and are not used as current execution premises. The contracts for actual movement, on-site participation, authority, single settlement, and save errors are retained. In case of conflict, follow the superseded scope in the [Singleplayer Detailed Design SP-1.0.0](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/). This does not mean implementation is complete or that existing saves are automatically converted.

Campaign progression is measured by how long the order established by named actors holds. Growth stages and crisis effects are tracked through spheres of influence and the connection graph. It is not implemented yet.

Progression is measured not by territory numbers but by a base's stabilization, specialization, and connected projection power, together with the legitimacy of the order the player has built. The figures below are **design assumptions**.

v3 time: a campaign turn is one month, and a year is twelve turns (09 §3.2, 07 §13). The day and week values below are design assumptions for finer settlement inside that turn; their conversion to turns is decided together with OD-MOVE in the undecided ledger (provisional T21-rules-a-1).

## Inputs and Outputs

| Input | Range and Default Values | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Security `S_i` | 0–100, stable base 70 | Violence deterrence and defense |
| Function `F_i` | 0–100, stable base 70 | Facilities, production, and shelter services |
| Legitimacy `L_i` | 0–100, stable base 60 | Acceptance of local rule |
| Connectivity `K_i` | 0~1 | Relief, Trade, and Reinforcement Potential |
| Shortage `x_i` | 0~1 | Recovery/Output Penalty |
| Overextension `O` | 0~2 | Network-Wide Burden |
| Tension `E` | 0–100, starts at 20 | Weekly Crisis Probability and Intensity |

## Calculation Rules

```text
K_i = clamp(max_path(path_reliability), 0, 1)
shortage_i = 0 if demand is 0, otherwise 1 - clamp(available / demand, 0, 1)
recovery = clamp(10 + 10*crisis_resolution_quality, 0, 20)
E' = clamp(E + time_pressure + expansion_shock + shortage + isolation + overextension - recovery, 0, 100)
crisis_probability = clamp(0.10 + 0.01*(E-50) + 0.15*O + 0.10*mean_shortage + 0.10*mean_isolation, 0.10, 0.75)

```

Overextension `O` and isolation use, as is, the shared 0–2 scale defined in logistics and infrastructure, and `pyeonggyunbujok` (average shortage) and `pyeonggyungorip` (average isolation) are site-weight-weighted averages (denominator floor 0.25). The site weights used in aggregation are a **design assumption**: 1.0 for normal sites and 1.5 for transit sites (floor 0.25); the overextension scale itself is not changed. Items with demand 0 are treated as shortage 0, following the shared rules of economy and production, and are not divided by 0. `hoebok` (recovery) applies only if the crisis was resolved that week (resolution quality 0–1); if there is no resolution, it is 0. The crisis type and target are determined by the campaign seed, the week number, and a dedicated random stream, and the cause weights are recorded in the ledger. The family weights are a **design assumption**: shortage·contamination `1 + 4*pyeonggyunbujok`, isolation·blackout·route hijacking `1 + 4*pyeonggyungorip`, overextension·fragmentation·multi-front raiding `1 + 4*min(O, 1)`, and external shock `1 + E/100`; the target weight is `geojeomgajungchi_i * (1 + 2*bujok_i + 2*gorip_i + (1 - min(S_i, F_i, L_i) / 100))`.

## Base Values

| Item | Default | Min | Max |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Campaign Starting Tension | 20 | 0 | 100 |
| New Occupation Expansion Shock | 5 | 0 | 10 |
| Shortage Threshold | 0.25 | 0 | 1 |
| Severe Shortage Threshold | 0.75 | 0 | 1 |
| Severe Shortage Until Forced Response | 3 days | 1 day | 7 days |
| Severe Shortage Until Collapse Choice | 7 days | 3 days | 14 days |
| Crisis Probability | 10% | 10% | 75% |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Occupation] --> B[Stabilization]
  B --> C[Specialization]
  C --> D[Line Projection]
  D --> E[Order Charter]
  B -. Failure .-> R[Recovery Posture]
  D -. Overextension .-> R
  R --> B
  E --> V[Multi-Ending Evaluation]

```

## Edge Cases

- Three days of severe shortage trigger a forced regional emergency event, and seven days open the choices of withdrawal, forced rationing, surrender negotiations, and regional collapse.
- An isolated node can hold out on its stockpile, but because no witnesses, relief, or repair crews arrive, its recovery is slow.
- Overextension does not magically strengthen enemies; it shows up as administrative, patrol, and repair delays at every node.
- If several crises occur in the same week, the dedicated random result is fixed first, and then the crises are scheduled in crisis ID order.
- Victory is judged not by unifying Seoul alone but by charter conditions such as the terms of a water supply contract, sureties kept at contract meetings, a trade order, and technological restoration. There are only three factions, and no victory founds a new one (bible §1 row 7).

## Calculation Example

With tension 58, overextension 0.5, average shortage 0.139, and average isolation 0.2, `wigihwangnyul=clamp(0.10+0.08+0.075+0.0139+0.02,0.10,0.75)=0.2889`, that is, 28.89%. If the crisis ends with a resolution quality of 0.8, the recovery term for that week is `hoebok=clamp(10+10*0.8,0,20)=18`. This value is used only as a subtraction term in the `E'` formula, and `E'=E-18` holds only when the time-pressure, expansion-shock, shortage, isolation, and overextension increase terms for the same week are all 0. Successful recovery also becomes a substantive choice in campaign progress.

## Rules for How Incursions and Events Change the Faction Graph

The vertices of the faction graph are the people who hold seats and the sources of each seat's legitimacy. Seat holders are Assembly Member households, the head households and workbench households of the cities, and the Near Houses and the Hierophant's house. The source of legitimacy differs by faction: for the Government the ledger ("we carried the Republic of Korea on"), for the Free Cities the sureties kept and the contract sheets, for the Arc the Hierophant's word and the baptism roll (01-core §7, 09 §5). The edges are water supply contracts and their annexes, contract sheets and pledges, service at the Hierophant's side and the maintenance queue, marriage, hostility, and passage. Progress is measured not by occupied tiles but by the stability and legitimacy of this graph (provisional T21-rules-a-3).

Incursions and weekly crises do not erase vertices directly. First they fold or hide edges, or move their expiry weeks earlier. If a seat holder is captured or killed, an inheritance issue opens. Its axis is the named heir in the Government, the child who has shown a hand and the masters' meeting in the Free Cities, and blood inside the Near House together with part count in the Arc (09 §5). Faction objects are never deleted.

There are three axes along which an incursion can change the graph in a single week. The ledger axis moves the hands of Government stations through struck-off registrations and forced transfers. The contract axis turns an unkept sheet into a broken surety and hands the pledge over to the other side. The maintenance axis cuts an Arc station's maintenance queue and day-charge share or moves them to another station. When several changes occur in the same week, the dedicated random result is fixed first, and then they are scheduled in crisis ID order (provisional T21-rules-a-3).

When an external shock hits a node, that node opens one edge for a limited term with the nearest other node: an edge that borrows water, parts, or maintenance. If it is not repaid by the term, the edge remains as a debt or is cut. An incursion alone does not change a faction's name or a duchy's borders (provisional T21-rules-a-3).

When a maintenance queue is cut, a contract sheet is broken, or a ledger collapses, legitimacy `L_i` is recounted. Connectivity `K_i` is trimmed again to the maximum path reliability after the passage edge is cut. The tension `E'` and crisis probability formulas remain unchanged. The path of stabilization, specialization, line projection, and order charter after occupation also remains unchanged. No stage is added to the six-stage loop.

Events on the timeline do not replay a fixed outcome. An event opens conditions, and the outcome is decided by the ambitions, fears, relationships, memories, and positions of living characters. If a key figure dies, is captured, or is persuaded, another character can lead the same event and produce a different result.

The old faith axes (debris rite authority, symbol pedestal, mechanical piety) are retired. There is one organised faith, the Arc (bible §1 row 9), so faith axes exist only at Arc stations. The axes are `Bap` (the share of the station's people who are baptised), `Tithe` (the share of households that gave on time), and `Svc` (the share of the baptised who received their maintenance turn on time), each 0–100. The opening default is 50 at Arc stations; stations of the other factions have no faith axes. This is a **design assumption** (provisional T21-rules-a-4).

If parts are looted or the maintenance bench collapses, `Svc` falls and reputation drops. `Tithe` rises with generous giving and falls with short giving, which pushes the maintenance queue later (06 §8.4). `Bap` rises only through baptism and falls when a baptised person dies. At an Arc station that has lost its maintenance bench, an issue opens in which another faction tries to take the station.

## Opening Policy Table (v3 Three Factions)

The opening policy tables keyed to the old polities (the Korean and the English table) are retired (01-core §10). The v3 opening policy is one row per faction, and each cell is taken from 01-core §§5, 7, 8, 03 §11, and 09 §§4–5. The Free Cities differ city by city, so this table gives only the frame and the per-city values follow chapter 05 (provisional T21-rules-a-5).

| Faction | War | People off the ledger | Water | Labor | Records | Technology | Trade | Succession |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Government (14 districts north of the Han) | An army that defends. It does not cross the river with armies | Anyone not on the ledger is not a citizen; to take someone in, register them | Party to the first and second water supply contracts. Guui and Ttukdo intakes | Registered residents. Recorded work is inherited, and residence cannot be changed at will | The ledger (registration and striking-off) | Salvage and papers of the Republic of Korea's institutions. Maintenance is borrowed through the water supply contract | Meal coupons are used only inside the ledger. Deals across the river are made by annex | Inherited seats. The President for Life by acclamation of fourteen seals |
| Free Cities (7 southwestern districts) | No standing army. They fight with watch shares and contract forces | A workbench takes in anyone who shows a hand | Parties to the first and second water supply contracts. Each city contracts separately | Workbench hands, counted in hand-hours | Contract sheets and sureties | Building and repairing wind frames, heat pumps, well pumps, and water wheels | Markets and contracts, counted in kilos | A head for life chosen by name-worth at the masters' meeting. Gwanak: a duke who bound the seals |
| Arc (4 Gangnam districts) | Fights short. Returns before the parts run dry | Takes people in through baptism | Sits at the third water supply contract for the first time. Jamsil weir power and the Amsa intake | Near Houses and maintenance benches share out meals. Counted in maintenance turns | The Hierophant's word (never written) and the baptism roll | Fitting, maintenance, and charging of cyberware | No market. Trades in day-charges and maintenance turns | The Hierophant's bloodline and the Near Houses. The next Near House head needs two parts or more |

## Four Axes Linking Daily Life, Domain, and Personal Politics

The design scope connects daily life, relationships, livelihood, production, logistics, marriage, diplomacy, technology transmission, mobilization, and raids to combat and movement (Decision 15 of 2026-10-02). The player is not a faction but a single person of one household, who gains authority to act through an occupation, an office, and confirmation. Shortages in daily life change labor and mood, and the results of production and supply lead to loyalty, war, and succession. Injury and detention carry over into labor and relationships. What follows is a plan that distinguishes the scope already reflected from the inputs still undecided; it does not mean the game has been fully implemented. The strategy map's viewpoint follows the location and known information of the main-body character selected from the map list. The default display layer is the factions' political territory, showing diplomacy, domains, titles, offices, the political situation, and the combat situation. Subway and railway lines are an optional display layer and are off by default. The settlement screen shows the settlement where the main body is actually present, and direct on-site control targets only the main body. Other characters act according to their own goals, livelihoods, and schedules, and can be the target of conversation and orders. Affiliated faction, relationship edges, and physical location are separate things. The list is read from the actual character, faction, and relationship ledgers, and affiliation or relationship alone does not grant cohabitation or command authority. If there is no current location, it is left as unconfirmed, and a scenario placement is not fixed as the opening location.

| Axis | Existing Contract and Scope of Reflection | Inputs Not Yet Decided | Where Reflected |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Exploration | Maintain the two movement layers, time-based route travel, reconnaissance, encounters, and non-combat resolution, and link observation evidence to acquisition time. Remote command does not imply omniscient observation authority. | Movement speed, layer transitions and risk costs, fog of war, information staleness, and exploration rewards | Travel and encounters, hero squads and movement, and the observation fields of the data ledger |
| Expansion | Maintain the contracts for conflict, occupation, stabilization, integration, and the holding of seats (the Government's ration shares and levy steps, the Free Cities' contract sheets, the Arc's maintenance queue, 09 §5). The strategy map's current map and play scope lies within Seoul's administrative boundary. Outside Seoul is the rim of the outer war machines and nobody rules it, so it is not something to acquire (01-core §6.3). Distinguish the acquisition of territory and buildings from confirmation, and link submission, assistance, and independence to the actor's authority, consent, and triggering events. The earlier review of the Chungnam-region POC included Daejeon, and the administrative IDs for Daejeon and Sejong remain in the source material surveyed at the time. Do not treat this as grounds for the current WIKI world map or information details, or for new grants or submissions within Seoul. | The cost, time, failure, and reversal of acquisition actions, and how the layers connect inside Seoul. | Strongholds and territory; the holding and succession clauses of factions and wars |
| Development | Link a mixed population of aggregate and individual residents and each faction's livelihood system with manpower reservation, bottleneck production, consumption upon actual arrival, and skilled-worker-centered use of technology. Records are a means of education and recovery. | The closed list of resources and facilities, construction costs and time, the capacity formula, faction and settlement levels, and per-technology education and recovery conditions | Economy and logistics, strongholds, the data ledger, and the rules for daily life, labor, and technology transmission |
| Elimination | Maintain individual attacks, active defense, DR, damage, injury, and fear checks; rules such as automatic and manual modes; melee engagement lock; full retreat; and single settlement by ResultId. War covers supply, lines of retreat, and maintenance after occupation. | The definition of operational power, the execution procedure for automatic combat, and the conditions for declaring war, making peace, and eliminating a faction | Individually adjudicated combat, round trips between strategy and combat, war and sieges, and factions and diplomacy |

## Confirmed Link Directions and Undecided Effects



## Settlement Boundaries and Review Cases

- Individualizing aggregate residents changes how an existing population is represented. People moved to the individual roster are not counted in aggregate labor again. Recruitment, injury, detention, discharge, and return must follow the same person and labor reservation. Using a case of individualizing 5 of 500 residents and mobilizing 3, review the preservation of total population, occupations, and available shifts. The numbers are review inputs, not rules that set spawn rates or capacity.
- Cargo distinguishes dispatch stock, in-transit ownership, and arrival stock. It cannot be consumed before arrival, and route quality differs from the amount actually delivered. Define the order when the daily close and an arrival fall on the same world time, how long-distance multi-leg progress works, and whether arrivals can be consumed the same day, together with the economic resolution order. Daily settlement does not restore simultaneous strategy turns.
- Compare the effects on next-day labor and on base cooperation, stabilization, and integration in the case of zero water with sufficient food and power. Do not assume that water shortage is the same as existing food or power shortages, and do not assume that it has no effect on bases. Do not apply the labor penalty for shortage twice, in both livelihood and economy. Do not feed rations already received back into the same daily-necessities purchase demand.
- Separate relationship T, loyalty, reputation, and legitimacy, and define the settlement order for daily loyalty, weekly diplomacy, and marriage events. The cost, duration, and concurrent-action constraints of repeated rewards and threats are undecided. For each interview, ration, reward, and marriage, check the actor, authority, consent, supplies, world time, and failure reason.
- Review, by skill, the case of losing a skilled person → inability to perform → training through remaining records and tools → recovery. Command refusal during combat, duplicate ResultId, death without a successor, and the checkpoint when the last participant leaves preserve the existing resolution and save contracts. These cases are design review conditions, not evidence that execution tests have passed.

## Implementation Order and Ownership Boundaries

Implement in this order: alignment of the latest combat, movement, and capacity authority → resident individualization, labor, and supply preservation → per-faction livelihood, production, and transport → marriage, succession, and technology transmission → mobilization, encounter, and combat settlement → data, save, and observation contracts → blueprints and derivatives. Distinguish confirmed direction, detailed proposals, undecided values, and implementation status. The WIKI owns world data on characters, facilities, culture, and technology lineages, while the GDD owns the rules for actions, authority, consumption, and settlement. After checking the references and versions of the execution paths that read organization and resident-generation data, transfer ownership; do not edit generated HTML directly.

## System Contract for the Character-Perspective POC

Organize the prototype reviewed by the owner and the behavior the owner later corrected directly into state, authority, and information contracts. Changes to the execution engine or the published URL are not additional approval of game rules. Distinguish the confirmed direction below from experimental implementation and undecided details. The seconds, prices, damage, capacity formulas, and character placements used in the Godot and web prototypes are not canonical confirmed values. The final product migration also preserves the same stable character, region, command, and result IDs and their causal events.

| System | Confirmed Contract | State and Input/Output Boundaries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Start and Perspective | Title → Main Menu → map-based selection of an opening character → start from the selected character's perspective. Each screen is mutually exclusive. | Eligibility for selection and the starting location are checked against the source and approval status. The player character ID does not change through target selection after the start. The world clock and game HUD are activated after the game starts. |
| Strategy and Map | The strategy map shows diplomacy, domains, titles, political conditions, and combat situations. Political, title, surface, and underground modes are kept separate. | Faction names and faction colors are the common display of control. Titles, indicators, and station control are separate data layers, and the control color does not create rights in other layers. Administrative boundaries and territorial boundaries are distinguished. |
| Underground Connections | Use actual adjacent next-station connections, and do not turn express services that skip intermediate stations into movement edges. | Separate the service line, the physical connection, and the passage status. Unverified connections allow neither display nor movement, and leave the source ID, version, and verification status. |
| Characters and Places | Affiliation, relationships, and current location are different facts. Only characters at the same location appear in a settlement. | Faction members and related persons can be looked up remotely, but looking up or selecting them does not imply movement, cohabitation, or command authority. An unrecorded location remains unconfirmed. |
| Direct Control and Commands | Only the one player character is controlled directly. NPCs act autonomously according to their goals, desires, work, and rest schedules. | Separate the target selection ID from the player character ID. Commands and conversations check the actor's authority, relationship type, direction, location, distance, current schedule, and reason for refusal. |
| Combat Participation | An encounter event creates combat. Only combat in which the player character actually participates displays a battlefield, and it is incompatible with the settlement screen. | Combat in which the player character does not participate proceeds automatically under the same individual rules, and the strategy map shows only the situation and result. Check participant positions, labor reservations, and the result ID, and settle only once. |
| Situation Transitions | Settlements and combat in which the player participates switch through a single situation entry item. | Normally the current settlement; combat while the player character participates; entry is not possible while the player character is moving. Remote non-participating combat does not change the player character's situation entry item to combat. |
| Relationships and Presentation | Character selection is shown with portrait cards fixed to the map and a selection detail panel, and relationships and factions are shown as ledger nodes and directed edges centered on the player character. | Card pan, zoom, and off-screen exclusion preserve map coordinates. Relationships are not generated by inference. The player character's local marker masks the registered portrait in a circle, and unregistered characters are displayed as unregistered. |
| Title Data | Enter the territory, holder, and superior title for each of the five layers: station, dong, district (duchy), faction, and head (01-core §8). The land frame is the geographic titles of `121-map-titles.sql`, and the 25 districts are 14 Government, 7 Free Cities, and 4 Arc (bible §1 row 8). Check for empty ledgers, reference errors, superior-title cycles, and duplicate assignments, and display effective control and title rights separately. |

- Selecting a related person from another faction → the player character ID and current location are kept, and a command to a contract partner without command authority is refused.
- Refuse entry to a settlement while the player character is traveling → after arrival, display only characters at the new location. Looking up members does not increase population or labor reservations.
- Refuse battlefield entry for combat the player character does not participate in and settle it automatically at the strategy level; refuse settlement entry for combat the player character participates in, return after the result, and refuse duplicate results.
- Do not fill blank title ledgers, unverified station connections, unregistered portraits, or unrecorded locations arbitrarily from other materials. Record review cases separately from evidence of execution passing.

## Decision Contract for Undecided Gameplay Items

The following GP items are design proposals for closing decision questions. A proposal is not confirmed merely because it exists in a document or has been run in a prototype. Until approved, keep no value, action refusal, and the specified scenario scope. Numbers, probabilities, costs, and durations are not created outside the current contract and are registered after ledger evidence and an owner decision. First close the data, authority, and preservation boundaries, then decide chains, political effects, and resolution inputs.

| Item | Questions to Decide | Design Proposal and Default Boundary | Input/Output and Failure/Verification Cases | Canonical Ownership |

How should detailed restrictions such as age and detention, and the handling of starting-location evidence and conflicts, be decided? | Confirmed: All living opening characters are selectable regardless of affiliation or position. Proposal: Give priority to the opening version and confirmed location in the authoring ledger, and allow unrecorded locations only through explicitly approved scenario placement. Detailed restrictions are undecided. | Input character ID/time point/eligibility/location evidence → selectable or not, reason, starting location. Cases of future appearance, minors, and location conflicts. | Hero-Squads; data ledger; WIKI character and location sources |
| GP-02 Movement and Information | Movement by distance, means, and state; observation and report information; and information and opportunity rewards are confirmed. How should speed, modifiers, obsolescence, and scouting events be decided? | The confirmed direction follows the distance, observation, and exploration clauses of travel and encounters. Store the source route, report basis, and acquisition time, and do not repeatedly generate fixed resource rewards. | Input route/means/personnel/cargo/right of passage → scheduled arrival, actual arrival, interruption, observation update. Cases of blocked connections, outdated control, and unverified stations. | Travel; Economy; data observation and transport |
| GP-03 Orders and Schedules | Orders are passed along contact routes, and schedule conflicts are handled through deferral, refusal, or negotiation. How should delegation, contact cost and time, acceptance checks, and the re-evaluation order be set? | Confirmed: order delivery, receipt, acceptance, and execution are separate, and depend on the availability of messengers, radio, and contact networks. Impossible states such as safety, physiological, and detention conditions take priority, and deferral, refusal, and negotiation based on loyalty, relationships, and authority remain possible. Cases: no command authority within the same faction, conflicting orders, lost contact. | Hero-Squads; Factions; Daily Life and Schedule Contracts |
| GP-04 Daily Life, Population, and Labor | What are the scope of personalization, consumption, wages/rations, and the settlement order in which shortages carry over to labor, mood, and strongholds? | Proposal: preserve movement between aggregates and the individual roster as causal events, and check one reservation per worker. A shortage's labor loss is applied only at a single settlement boundary. | Input: population/occupation/reservation/rations/needs → available labor, fulfillment, discontent, return. Cases: conscription/treatment/cargo overlap, food sufficient with zero water, ration and purchase overlap. | Economy; Strongholds; Resident Life |
| GP-05 Production, Facilities, and Construction | Construction that consumes resources per stage and demand-driven reserved production are confirmed. What are the resource and facility lists, the cost and duration per stage, and the salvage recovered on dismantling? | Confirmed: only stages with qualified labor, tools, and materials proceed; on interruption, progress and unused materials are preserved; consumed materials are not refunded automatically. Follow the detailed economy provisions. | Input: order/facility/resources/authority → reservation, partial completion, completion, interruption. Cases: zero demand, no power, facility captured, transfer during construction. | Economy; Strongholds; Data Lists |

What about split cargo, blockades, actual inventory ownership, and the cutoff interval? | Confirmed: after verifying arrivals at the same moment, proceed to reservation, production, and consumption, with causal and acceptance order and blocking of duplicate arrivals. Cases: simultaneous arrival/blockade, split cargo, retransmission, duplicate arrival. | Economy; Save-and-Determinism |

What are the acquisition and integration costs and durations, and the system for unassigned titles? | Confirmed: occupation or transfer is a different state from legal rights, cooperation, and administration. Titles await confirmed wiki input, and claims, casus belli, and ratification follow the detailed faction and war provisions. | Input: region/title/actor/contract/ratification → acquisition, refusal, dispute, rights change. Cases: melee orders, surrender/rout/retreat, loss of commander, both sides knocked out simultaneously. | Realtime Battle; Rules-Battle; Warfare |
| GP-12 Encounter, Entry, and Exit | Incorporating permitted reinforcements after actual arrival is confirmed. What are the details of entry points, initial stance, command authority, main body withdrawal/capture, and end-of-session contention? | Proposal: manage a single lifecycle of strategic encounter → closed-session participant confirmation → main body participation check → on-site/automatic display → result → return to the campaign. | Input: place/time/participants/escape route/reinforcements → session, display authority, return. Cases: late arrival during progress, main body captured, remote battle spectate request, duplicate ResultId. | Strategy-Battle-Roundtrip; Travel; Hero-Squads |

Align proxy authority for an absent main body and the scope of public information with ADR-008. | Input: participant/authority/observation/save version → proxy, world pause, recovery, error. Each item records its decision rationale, version, authoritative document owner, and execution/document verification results separately. State shared by multiple systems, such as succession, observation, and settlement, has a single owner and is referenced from other documents.

## State Contract for Characters, Authority, and Labor

A character has a permanent character ID, affiliation, main body occupancy, current location/movement state, basis of authority, schedule/goals, and labor reservations as separate fields. Main body occupancy is separated from the selection of interaction targets. Changes of affiliation, changes of relationships, movement, and ratification of office are each causal events, and no single change automatically determines the other fields. An unrecorded location differs from being currently absent, and without evidence to judge whether they are in the same place, a character is not displayed as local.

| Target | State Transition | Inspection, Preservation, Refusal |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Main Body Start | Selection candidate → eligibility check → occupancy/starting location confirmed → on site or in transit | Checks the opening edition, the living character ID, and the basis for the location. All living opening characters are selectable regardless of affiliation or rank (owner-confirmed). Detailed restrictions such as age and detention are not yet decided, and the current POC's adult filter is not adopted as a product restriction. Selecting a different target does not change main body occupancy. |
| Location | On site → departure reserved → in transit → arrived/interrupted → on site, detained, or participating in combat | Departure and arrival events update the current location. A character in transit along a route does not exist in another settlement at the same time. A request to look up or summon an associated person does not imply arrival. |
| Command | Drafted → authority check → in delivery → received by target → accepted/deferred/refused → reserved → executed → completed/canceled | Checks the command type, direction, scope of delegation, the actual contact channel, and the target's state. A remote command is delivered by whatever means are available, such as couriers, radio, or contact networks, and is executed after the target receives and accepts it (owner-confirmed). If it conflicts with needs, goals, or an existing schedule, the deferral, refusal, or negotiation is recorded, and a command does not automatically erase personal goals. The delivery time and the detailed values for acceptance checks and priority are undecided. |
| Conversation and Interaction | Target lookup → on-site/contactable check → interaction → character/contract event | A lookup does not create command authority. Access conditions for distant locations, detention, combat, and lost contact differ by interaction. Direct control is not granted over every member of the same faction. |
| NPC Schedule | Evaluate goals, needs, and roles → select a possible action → reserve resources/time → move/act → result → re-evaluate | Only actions that fit the character's abilities, tools, authority, health, and location are executed. Impossible conditions such as safety, physiological needs, and detention take priority, and deferral, refusal, or negotiation of commands is recorded according to loyalty, relationships, authority, and the existing schedule (owner-confirmed). The check values and the action-selection algorithm are undecided. Releasing the existing reservation and acquiring the new one in a schedule change are recorded as a single transition. |
| Aggregate and Individual Population | Aggregate members → individualization mapped to individual IDs → role/reservation change → aggregate/individual sum | Individualization is not population creation. Individualized people are not counted again in aggregate available labor. Birth, death, migration, and capture are population/personnel events, not representation transitions. |
| Labor · Mobilization | Available → facility/transport/unit/treatment reservation → performance → completed/injured/interrupted → return eligibility check | A person is not reserved for overlapping roles in the same time interval. Absence of skills, absence of equipment, travel, and injury are different from available labor. Returning does not create a new character or reactivate the reservations of the dead. |
| Livelihood and Shortage | Consumption right/reservation → allocation → actual issuance/arrival → consumption → satisfied/short → constraints on next actions | Receiving rations and purchase demand are not duplicated. The same labor loss caused by shortage is not applied twice, in livelihood and in the economy. Satisfaction is recorded as a state separate from mood, loyalty, and T. |

- Even if 5 of a population of 500 are individualized and 3 are mobilized, the total population stays the same, and they are not duplicated in facility/aggregate labor for that time. When 1 injured person is treated and returns, the existing ID and reservations are carried over. The numbers are validation inputs.
- When a command is sent to a contract counterpart of another faction, a non-commanded target of the same faction, or a target whose command delegation has expired, the authority check results are distinguished. Review cancellation/deferral for a base relocation before the command is received, a severed contact channel, and target detention.
- If individualization and production deadlines, mobilization and treatment, or arrival and consumption occur at the same world time, reservations and totals are replayed by acceptance order and causal events. Reapplying the same event does not increase population, supplies, or available labor.

## Accumulated Decisions and Remaining Combat Proposals

Movement is fixed by distance, means, and state; current information by observation and reports; exploration rewards by information and opportunities. Construction consumes actual resources by stage, production follows demand and reserved orders, and cargo includes verified arrivals up to the deadline time. Effective control and recognition are separated from title rights, and excess personnel are preserved when the quota is reduced. Marriage by faction, termination by effect, education by technology, separate claim actions by spouse claims, child inheritance, succession, and authorized handlers, and the need for a casus belli in every war are applied. Specific coefficients, times, and costs, as well as unassigned institutions/titles, are undecided.

| Unanswered Items | Design Proposal — Not Final | Approval Boundaries to Maintain |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Automatic Combat Policy — Final | The local commander decides based on the prior objective, posture, and authority, together with observed information, capabilities, and goals. | Remote instruction delivery and acceptance, close-range locks, identical resolution for automatic and manual execution, and a single result ledger are maintained. The detailed policy function is undecided. |
| Operational Strength and Original Formula — Scope Final | Starting from the basic individual abilities and checks, all three scopes are designed: redesign of individual hit/defense/damage/injury, command, supply, and battlefield modifiers, and unit aggregate calculation. | It is not finalized on simple estimated metrics alone. The actual functions, coefficients, aggregate damage distribution, and application channels are undecided, and applying the same loss twice to individuals and aggregates is prohibited. |
| Late Joining — Final | Joins after actual arrival that satisfies the reinforcement conditions and entry route set at the start. | After the main body is actually incorporated, field screen access is updated, and it is exclusive with settlements. It does not join a session that has already ended or retroactively apply past damage. |

Items previously managed as unanswered proposals were finalized up to the scope above by the owner's additional response on 2026-10-03. The calculation coefficients, algorithms, and detailed reinforcement conditions are still undecided, and prototype runtime values are not finalized as they are. The individual-check combat and strategy–combat round-trip documents own the execution/settlement contracts.

# 캠페인 진행과 위기

현재 제품 기획은 SP-1.0.0 싱글플레이 상세 계약을 우선한다. 한 플레이어·한 본체·NPC·단일 캠페인 저장을 사용하며 이 문서의 공유 세계·최대 참가자·호스트·접속 종료·점유·온라인 대행 조항은 역사로 보존하고 현재 실행 전제로 사용하지 않는다. 실제 이동·현장 참가·권한·단일 정산·저장 오류 계약은 유지한다. 충돌 시 [싱글플레이 상세 기획 SP-1.0.0](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)의 대체 범위를 따른다. 구현 완료나 기존 저장 자동 변환을 뜻하지 않는다.

캠페인 진행은 이름 있는 행위자가 세운 질서가 얼마나 버티는지로 잰다. 성장 단계와 위기 영향은 영향권과 연결 그래프로 추적한다. 구현 완료가 아니다.

진행은 영토 숫자가 아니라 거점의 안정화, 전문화, 연결 투사력과 플레이어가 세운 질서의 정당성으로 측정합니다. 아래 수치는 **설계 가정**입니다.

v3 시간: 캠페인 턴은 한 달이고 한 해는 열두 턴이다(09장 3.2절, 07장 13절). 아래의 일·주 단위 값은 그 턴 안에서 쓰는 세부 정산의 설계 가정이며, 턴과의 환산은 미결정 원장 OD-MOVE와 함께 정한다 (잠정 T21-rules-a-1).

## 입력과 출력

| 입력 | 범위·기본값 | 출력 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 안보 `S_i` | 0~100, 안정 거점 70 | 폭력 억제와 방어 |
| 기능 `F_i` | 0~100, 안정 거점 70 | 시설·생산·피난 서비스 |
| 정통성 `L_i` | 0~100, 안정 거점 60 | 현지 통치 수용 |
| 연결 `K_i` | 0~1 | 구호·교역·증원 가능성 |
| 부족 `x_i` | 0~1 | 회복·산출 감점 |
| 과확장 `O` | 0~2 | 네트워크 전체 부담 |
| 긴장도 `E` | 0~100, 시작 20 | 주간 위기 확률과 강도 |

## 계산 규칙

```text
K_i = clamp(max_path(경로신뢰도), 0, 1)
부족_i = 수요가 0이면 0, 아니면 1 - clamp(가용량 / 수요, 0, 1)
회복 = clamp(10 + 10*위기해결품질, 0, 20)
E' = clamp(E + 시간압력 + 확장충격 + 부족 + 고립 + 과확장 - 회복, 0, 100)
위기확률 = clamp(0.10 + 0.01*(E-50) + 0.15*O + 0.10*평균부족 + 0.10*평균고립, 0.10, 0.75)

```

과확장 `O`와 고립은 물류와 기반 시설에 정의된 공유 0~2 척도를 그대로 사용하며, `평균부족`과 `평균고립`은 거점 가중치 가중 평균(분모 하한 0.25)입니다. 집계에 쓰는 거점 가중치는 **설계 가정**으로 일반 1.0, 환승 1.5(하한 0.25)이며 과확장 척도 자체는 바꾸지 않습니다. 수요가 0인 항목은 경제와 생산의 공유 규칙대로 부족 0으로 처리하고 0으로 나누지 않습니다. `회복`은 그 주에 위기를 해결했을 때만 적용하며(해결 품질 0~1), 해결이 없으면 0입니다. 위기 종류와 대상은 캠페인 시드, 주차와 전용 난수 흐름으로 결정하며 원인 가중치를 원장에 기록합니다. 계열 가중치는 **설계 가정**으로 부족·오염 `1 + 4*평균부족`, 고립·정전·경로 탈취 `1 + 4*평균고립`, 과확장·분열·다면 전선 약탈 `1 + 4*min(O, 1)`, 외부 충격 `1 + E/100`이고, 대상 가중치는 `거점가중치_i * (1 + 2*부족_i + 2*고립_i + (1 - min(S_i, F_i, L_i) / 100))`입니다.

## 경계 상황

- 심각 부족 3일은 강제 지역 비상사건, 7일은 철수·배급 강제·항복 협상·지역 붕괴 선택을 엽니다.
- 고립된 거점은 비축으로 버틸 수 있지만 증인·구호·수리 인력이 오지 않아 회복이 느립니다.
- 과확장은 적을 마법처럼 강화하지 않고 모든 거점의 행정·순찰·수리 지연으로 나타납니다.
- 같은 주에 여러 위기가 발생하면 전용 난수 결과를 고정한 뒤 위기 ID 순서로 예약합니다.
- 승리는 서울을 하나로 묶는 것만이 아니라 급수계약의 조건, 계약회에서 지킨 보증, 교역 질서, 기술 복구 같은 헌장 조건으로 평가합니다. 세력은 셋뿐이고 새 세력을 세우는 승리는 없습니다(바이블 1절 7행).

## 계산 예시

긴장도 58, 과확장 0.5, 평균 부족 0.139, 평균 고립 0.2이면 `위기확률=clamp(0.10+0.08+0.075+0.0139+0.02,0.10,0.75)=0.2889`, 즉 28.89%입니다. 위기가 해결 품질 0.8로 끝나면 그 주의 회복 항은 `회복=clamp(10+10*0.8,0,20)=18`입니다. 이 값은 `E'` 공식에서 차감 항으로만 쓰이며, 같은 주의 시간압력·확장충격·부족·고립·과확장 증가 항이 모두 0일 때만 `E'=E-18`이 됩니다. 성공적인 회복도 캠페인 진행의 실질적 선택이 됩니다.

## 침입과 사건이 세력 그래프를 바꾸는 규칙

세력 그래프의 꼭짓점은 자리를 쥔 사람과 그 자리의 정당성 원천입니다. 자리를 쥔 사람은 국회의원 집안, 도시의 우두머리 집안과 작업대 집안, 곁집과 교주의 집입니다. 정당성 원천은 세력마다 다릅니다. 정부는 "대한민국을 이어 왔다"는 장부, 자유도시들은 지킨 보증과 계약서 장, 아크는 교주의 말과 세례 명단입니다(01-core 7절, 09장 5절). 변은 급수계약과 그 부속서, 계약서 장과 맡김, 곁 섬김과 정비 순번, 혼인, 적대, 통행입니다. 진행은 점령 칸이 아니라 이 그래프의 안정과 정통성으로 측정합니다 (잠정 T21-rules-a-3).

침입과 주간 위기는 꼭짓점을 바로 지우지 않습니다. 변을 접거나 숨기거나 만료 주를 당기는 일이 먼저입니다. 자리를 쥔 사람이 붙잡히거나 죽으면 대물림 쟁점을 엽니다. 정부는 지명된 후계, 자유도시들은 손을 보인 자식과 대주회, 아크는 곁집 안의 핏줄과 부위 수가 그 쟁점의 축입니다(09장 5절). 세력 객체는 지우지 않습니다.

한 주에 침입이 그래프를 바꾸는 축은 세 가지입니다. 장부 축은 등재민의 말소와 강제 전입으로 정부 역의 일손을 옮깁니다. 계약 축은 지키지 못한 장을 깨진 보증으로 바꾸고 맡김을 상대에게 넘깁니다. 정비 축은 아크 역의 정비 순번과 하루 충전 몫을 끊거나 다른 역으로 옮깁니다. 같은 주 여러 변형은 전용 난수를 고정한 뒤 위기 ID 순서로 예약합니다 (잠정 T21-rules-a-3).

외부 충격이 거점을 치면 그 거점은 가장 가까운 다른 거점과 맺은 변 하나를 기한부로 엽니다. 물이나 부품이나 정비를 빌리는 변입니다. 기한까지 되갚지 못하면 그 변은 빚으로 남거나 끊깁니다. 침입만으로 세력의 이름이나 공작령의 경계를 바꾸지 않습니다 (잠정 T21-rules-a-3).

정비 순번이 끊기거나 계약서 장이 깨지거나 장부가 무너지면 정통성 `L_i`를 다시 셉니다. 연결 `K_i`는 통행 변이 끊긴 뒤 경로 신뢰도 최댓값을 다시 자릅니다. 긴장도 `E'`와 위기확률 공식은 그대로입니다. 점령 다음의 안정화와 전문화와 노선 투사와 질서 헌장 경로도 그대로입니다. 여섯 단계 루프에 단계를 더하지 않습니다.

연표의 사건은 정해진 결과를 재생하지 않습니다. 사건은 조건을 열고, 결과는 살아 있는 인물의 야망·공포·관계·기억·직위가 정합니다. 핵심 인물이 죽거나 포획되거나 설득되면 같은 사건을 다른 인물이 이끌어 다른 결과를 낼 수 있습니다.

옛 신앙 축(잔해 제사권, 상징 좌대, 기계 경건)은 폐기했습니다. 조직된 신앙은 아크 하나이므로(바이블 1절 9행) 신앙 축은 아크 역에만 있습니다. 축은 `Bap`(그 역 사람 가운데 세례받은 사람의 비율)·`Tithe`(바침을 제때 낸 집안의 비율)·`Svc`(정비 차례를 제때 받은 세례자의 비율)이고 범위는 0~100입니다. 개막 기본값은 아크 역에서 50이고 다른 세력의 역에는 축이 없습니다. **설계 가정**입니다 (잠정 T21-rules-a-4).

부품이 털리거나 정비대가 무너지면 `Svc`가 줄고 평판이 떨어집니다. `Tithe`는 넉넉히 바치면 오르고 덜 바치면 내려 정비 순번이 늦어집니다(06장 8.4절). `Bap`은 세례로만 오르고, 세례받은 사람이 죽으면 내려갑니다. 정비대를 잃은 아크 역에서는 다른 세력이 그 역을 쥐려는 쟁점이 열립니다.

## 생활·영지·인물 정치를 잇는 네 축

## 정산 경계와 검토 사례

- 집계 주민의 개인화는 기존 인구의 표현을 바꾸는 일이다. 개인 명부로 옮긴 사람은 집계 노동에 다시 포함하지 않는다. 모집·부상·구금·제대·복귀는 동일한 인물과 노동 예약을 따라야 한다. 인구 500명 중 5명을 개인화하고 3명을 소집하는 사례에서 총인구·직능·가용 교대의 보존을 검토한다. 숫자는 검토 입력이며 생성률·정원을 정하는 규칙이 아니다.
- 화물은 발송 재고·이동 중 소유·도착 재고를 구분한다. 도착 전 소비할 수 없으며 경로 품질과 실제 도착량은 다르다. 하루 마감과 도착이 같은 세계 시간일 때 순서, 장거리 여러 구간 진행과 당일 소비 가능 여부를 경제 판정 순서와 함께 정의한다. 일일 정산은 동시 전략 턴을 복원하지 않는다.
- 물 0·식량과 전력 충분 사례에서 다음 날 노동과 거점 협력·안정화·통합이 받는 영향을 대조한다. 물 부족을 기존 식량·전력 부족과 같다고 추정하거나 거점에 영향이 없다고 단정하지 않는다. 부족에 따른 노동 감점을 생활·경제에서 두 번 적용하지 않는다. 배급 수령분을 같은 생필품 구매 수요에 다시 넣지 않는다.
- 관계 T·충성·평판·정통성을 분리하고 일일 충성·주간 외교·혼인 사건의 정산 순서를 정의한다. 반복 보상·위협의 비용·기간·동시 행동 제약은 미정이다. 면담·배급·보상·혼인마다 행위자·권한·동의·물자·세계 시간과 실패 이유를 확인한다.
- 숙련자 상실→수행 불가→남은 기록·도구를 통한 교육→복구 사례를 기술별로 검토한다. 교전 중 명령 거절, 중복 ResultId, 후계 없는 사망, 마지막 참가자 이탈 체크포인트는 기존 판정·저장 계약을 보존한다. 이 사례는 설계 검토 조건이지 실행 테스트 통과 증거가 아니다.

## 반영 순서와 소유 경계

최신 전투·이동·정원 권위 정렬→주민 개인화·노동·물자 보존→세력별 생계와 생산·운송→혼인·계승·기술 전승→동원·조우·전투 정산→데이터·저장·관측 계약→청사진·파생물 순으로 반영한다. 확정 방향, 세부 제안, 미정 수치와 구현 상태를 구분한다. WIKI는 인물·시설·문화·기술 계보의 세계 데이터를 소유하고 GDD는 행동·권한·소비·정산 규칙을 소유한다. 편성·주민 생성 자료를 읽는 실행 경로의 참조와 판본을 확인한 뒤 소유를 이관하며 생성 HTML을 직접 수정하지 않는다.

## 인물·권한·노동의 상태 계약

한 인물은 영구 인물 ID, 소속, 본체 점유, 현재 장소/이동 상태, 권한 근거, 일정/목표, 노동 예약을 별도 필드로 가진다. 본체 점유와 상호작용 대상 선택을 분리한다. 소속 변경·관계 변경·이동·관직 인준은 각각 원인 사건이며 하나의 변경이 다른 필드를 자동으로 확정하지 않는다. 소재지 미기록과 현재 없음은 서로 다르고, 같은 장소 여부를 판단할 증거가 없으면 현지 인물로 표시하지 않는다.

## 누적 결정과 남은 전투 제안

이동은 거리·수단·상태, 현재 정보는 관측·보고, 탐사 보상은 정보·기회로 확정됐다. 건설은 단계별 실제 소비, 생산은 수요·예약 주문, 화물은 마감 시각 이하 검증 도착분을 포함한다. 실효 지배·인준과 작위 권리를 분리하며 정원 감소 때 초과 인원을 보존한다. 세력별 혼인과 효과별 종료, 기술별 교육, 배우자 주장·자녀 상속·계승 및 권한 있는 담당자의 별도 주장 조작, 모든 전쟁의 명분 필요를 적용한다. 구체 계수·시간·비용과 미배정 제도/작위는 미정이다.

# CH1 Characters and People

The latest independent verification, depth-verification-20261027.md:1855-1900 (§9), judges the static evidence of the corrected depth-01/02/03 and the gap inventory as a PASS for synthesis input. The initial FAIL history is preserved. depth-04 is a PASS for limited static fidelity. This does not guarantee overall gameplay meaning, runtime causality, installation integrity, combat damage formulas, or recovery of the original Ghidra project metadata. The references below are only CK3 structural references and not authority for the Seoul product, and the mismatched totals, coping effects, clan formula, and legacy costs are not adopted as Seoul rules.

This chapter separates Seoul facts, CK3 references, and product authority. The institutions and numbers of the reference game are not promoted to Seoul rules. An approved contract does not mean implementation is complete, and the replacement scope of SP-1.0.0 takes precedence over past shared-world clauses.

External product source: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/tree/main (measured revision 3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53; citations use fixed-revision URLs). The CK3 evidence files are survey receipts from 2026-10-27 and are not build inputs. The integrity of that installation is unverified. Source paths and identifiers are survey notations and are not game UI display names.

[Parent Contract: Detailed Single-Player Design](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 1.1 Identity, Main Body, and Sheet

Seoul fact: Follows SP-1.0.0's one player, one main body, NPCs, and single-campaign save. Heroes are actors separate from foot soldiers (https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/AGENTS.md#L54-L62). What was confirmed on 2026-09-24 in the existing hero squad contract is a catalog of 1,004 heroes (the count at the time; the v3 people ledger holds 1,022 persons, and that count is a fixed fact) and six main combat classes: Guardian, Breakthrough, Staff, Relief, Scout, and Camp Follower. A combat class is not the same as a campaign role, rank, or command authority. Individual character lives are owned by LORE/WIKI and are not duplicated in this chapter.

## 1.2 Abilities, Skills, and Growth

Seoul fact: References the SP-1.0.0 main body and common execution contract and the character sheet contract as parent documents. Abilities are recorded by distinguishing qualification, execution, and performance, and numbers are not generated from a class name alone. CK3 reference: mechanics-02-character-rpg.md:44-77,175-257 shows the structure of skill and experience multipliers for education traits and lifestyle/perk links. Experience thresholds and growth speed are not Seoul rules. Product authority: the original skill list, experience curve, and ability modifier coefficients are undecided institutions.

v3 world basis: all 1,022 persons have the six abilities (diplomacy, martial, stewardship, intrigue, learning, prowess) on a 1–20 scale, computed from occupation and rank (07 §8). The five bands on screen are 1–3 very poor, 4–7 poor, 8–11 average, 12–15 good, and 16 or more excellent (09 §4.1). Arc people also carry a part count separate from their title, and part count sets title thresholds (07 §8.6).

## 1.3 Traits, Health, Needs, Mood, and Stress

CK3 reference: mechanics-02-character-rpg.md:78-94,125-173 shows the structure of mutually exclusive personalities and stress-threshold events. Since stress was not observed before the command, previous values are not back-calculated from add_stress observations. The coping link in depth-01-social-intrigue.md:1156-1203 is a corrected static reference, cited only within the depth-verification-20261027.md:1855-1900 PASS scope, and is not an adopted rule. Product authority: Seoul's trait, needs, and stress institutions and numbers are undecided institutions. The existing approved health and injury contract is not replaced by a new CK3 stress scale.

v3 world basis: the winter wears health down. Shallow stations, hunger, and short air reduce health, and a machine body loses health when it cannot reach maintenance and charging. Causes of stress add the long-night season, being struck off the ledger, failed maintenance, and refused baptism (09 §4.1, 03 §4).

## 1.4 Livelihood, Daily Routine, and Real-World Causes

Seoul fact: The existing approved hero squad contract explains magic-like effects through the real-world causes of fraud, medicine, agitation, equipment, information, and cyberware, drone, and maintenance skills (chapter 03), and does not make supernatural magic a default cause. Livelihood actions follow SP-1.0.0's proposal → qualification → acceptance → reservation → execution → receipt. Product authority: livelihood content, routine frequency, and recovery amounts are undecided institutions, and arbitrary periodic processing is not added before the CH5 activities and CH9 time model are closed.

[Product Decision Ledger — Undecided Items Are Owner Authority](/gdd/design/open-decisions/)

[Korean Orthography and Naming Rules](/gdd/design/korean-terminology-and-naming/)

## Ownership of Preservation Contracts and Decision Numbers

Product Decisions 13 (individual-check combat), 14 (time-based strategic movement), and 15 (variable quota) are owner decisions preserved in the approved rules documents below. They are in a different namespace from the mechanism D13/D14/D15 sheet numbers and do not approve the proposal sheet. SP-1.0.0 replaces the shared-world, participant, host, occupancy, and online-proxy clauses with historical scope, and maintains the contracts for actual movement, on-site participation, authority, single settlement, and save errors. pw-01 is a war-initiation threshold proposal, not an approved product decision number.

[Approval Ledger for Decisions 14 and 15 and Hero Classes](/gdd/rules/hero-squads-and-time-based-movement/)

[Decisions 13 and 15 and Responsibility for Individual, Situational, and Aggregate Calculation](/gdd/rules/personal-resolution-battle/)

# CH1 캐릭터·인물

최신 독립 검증: depth-verification-20261027.md:1855-1900(§9)은 정정된 depth-01/02/03 및 gap inventory의 정적 근거를 synthesis 입력 PASS로 판정한다. 최초 FAIL 이력은 보존한다. depth-04는 제한된 정적 충실도 PASS다. 이는 전체 게임플레이 의미·런타임 인과·설치 무결성·전투 피해식·Ghidra 원프로젝트 메타데이터 복원을 보증하지 않는다. 아래 참조는 CK3 구조 참고일 뿐 서울 제품 권한이 아니며 불일치했던 총계·코핑 효과·씨족 산식·유산 비용을 서울 규칙으로 채택하지 않는다.

이 장은 서울 사실·CK3 참조·제품 권한을 분리한다. 참조 게임의 제도·수치를 서울 규칙으로 승격하지 않는다. 승인 계약은 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않으며 SP-1.0.0의 대체 범위가 과거 공유 세계 조항보다 우선한다.

외부 제품 원천: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/tree/main (측정 revision 3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53; 인용은 고정 revision URL 사용). CK3 증거 파일은 2026-10-27 조사 영수증이며 빌드 입력이 아니다. 해당 설치본의 무결성은 미검증이다. 출처 경로와 식별자는 조사 표기이며 게임 UI 표시명이 아니다.

[상위 계약: 싱글플레이 상세 기획](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 1.1 신원·본체·시트

서울 사실: SP-1.0.0의 한 플레이어·한 본체·NPC·단일 캠페인 저장을 따른다. 영웅은 병졸과 별도 행위자다(https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/AGENTS.md#L54-L62). 기존 영웅 분대 계약의 2026-09-24 확정은 1,004명 영웅 카탈로그(당시 수. v3 인물 원장은 1,022명이며 인원은 고정 사실이다)와 주 전투 클래스 수호·돌파·참모·구호·척후·종군의 여섯 분류이며, 전투 클래스와 캠페인 역할·직위·지휘권은 같지 않다. 개별 인물 생애는 LORE/WIKI 소유이며 이 장에서 복제하지 않는다.

## 1.2 능력·기술·성장

서울 사실: SP-1.0.0 본체·공통 실행 계약과 인물 시트 계약을 상위로 참조한다. 능력은 자격·실행·성과를 구분해 기록하며 클래스 이름만으로 수치를 생성하지 않는다. CK3 참조: mechanics-02-character-rpg.md:44-77,175-257은 교육 특성의 스킬·경험 배율과 라이프스타일/선행 링크 구조다. 경험 문턱이나 성장 속도는 서울 규칙이 아니다. 제품 권한: 독자 스킬 목록·경험 곡선·능력 보정 계수는 제도 미정이다.

v3 세계 기준: 1,022명 모두가 여섯 능력치(외교·군사·관리·음모·학식·무용)를 1~20 값으로 가지며 값은 직업과 품계에서 계산한다(07장 8절). 화면의 다섯 띠는 1~3 아주 모자람, 4~7 모자람, 8~11 보통, 12~15 좋음, 16 이상 뛰어남이다(09장 4.1절). 아크 사람에게는 칭호와 따로 부위 수가 있고, 부위 수는 칭호의 문턱이 된다(07장 8.6절).

## 1.3 특성·건강·욕구·기분·스트레스

CK3 참조: mechanics-02-character-rpg.md:78-94,125-173은 상호배제 성격과 스트레스 임계 이벤트의 구조를 보인다. 명령 전 스트레스가 관찰되지 않았으므로 add_stress 관찰로 이전 값을 역산하지 않는다. depth-01-social-intrigue.md:1156-1203의 코핑 연결은 정정된 정적 참조 — depth-verification-20261027.md:1855-1900 PASS 범위에 한정 참조이며 채택 규칙이 아니다. 제품 권한: 서울 특성·욕구·스트레스 제도와 수치는 제도 미정. 기존 승인 건강·부상 계약을 새로운 CK3 스트레스 척도로 대체하지 않는다.

v3 세계 기준: 건강은 겨울이 깎는다. 얕은 역, 굶주림, 공기 모자람이 건강을 줄이고, 기계 몸은 정비와 충전에 닿지 못하면 건강을 잃는다. 스트레스의 원인에는 긴 밤 철, 말소, 정비 실패, 세례 거부가 더해진다(09장 4.1절, 03장 4절).

## 1.4 생활·일과와 현실 원인

서울 사실: 기존 영웅 분대 승인 계약은 마법 같은 체감을 사기·의술·선동·장비·정보와 사이버웨어·드론·정비 기술(03장)의 현실 원인으로 설명하며 초자연 마법을 기본 원인으로 두지 않는다. 생활 행동은 SP-1.0.0의 제안→자격→수락→예약→실행→영수증을 따른다. 제품 권한: 생활 콘텐츠·일과 빈도·회복량은 제도 미정이며 CH5 활동과 CH9 시간 모델이 닫히기 전 임의 주기 처리를 추가하지 않는다.

[제품 결정 원장 — 미결정은 소유자 권한](/gdd/design/open-decisions/)

[한국어 표기와 명명 규칙](/gdd/design/korean-terminology-and-naming/)

## 보존 계약과 결정 번호의 소유

제품 결정 13(개인 판정 전투)·14(시간 기반 전략 이동)·15(가변 정원)은 아래 승인 규칙 문서에 보존된 소유자 결정이다. 메커니즘 D13/D14/D15 시트 번호와 다른 이름공간이며 제안 시트를 승인하지 않는다. SP-1.0.0은 공유 세계·참가자·호스트·점유·온라인 대행 조항을 역사 범위로 대체하고 실제 이동·현장 참가·권한·단일 정산·저장 오류 계약을 유지한다. pw-01은 전쟁 개시 임계 제안이지 승인된 제품 결정 번호가 아니다.

Source paths and identifiers are survey notations and are not game UI display names.

[Parent Contract: Detailed Single-Player Design](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 7.1 Negotiation and Trade

Seoul fact: Maintains the SP-1.0.0 order of proposal → eligibility → acceptance → reservation → execution → receipt. Relationships or command authority are not automatically acquired through acceptance of a trade alone. CK3 reference: depth-01-social-intrigue.md:15-43 defines sender interest, recipient acceptance, validity, and after-effects separately. Not every interaction is reduced to a single probability roll. Product authority: Negotiation options, prices, and acceptance formulas are undecided in the system.

v3 world basis: there is no money used across all of Seoul, so a trade is a matter of matching both sides' reckoning. The Government counts in meals and workdays, the Free Cities in kilos and hand-hours, the Arc in day-charges and maintenance turns (03 §11). Government meal coupons are used only inside the ledger, and handing them to anyone off the ledger is forbidden by law.

## 7.2 Reinforcement and Contracts

CK3 reference: The stage-by-stage obligations and government-type-specific contract structures in mechanics-06-vassals-court-council.md:11-95 are reference material. Product authority: All Seoul policies on alliances, treaties, truces, conquest, and ownership transfer are undecided in the system. A war-declaration threshold proposal is not used as an approval statute.

v3 world basis: the great promise between the three factions is the water supply contract. It runs on a thirty-year cycle: the first in 2066, the second in 2096, and the third at the opening in 2126, where the Arc sits for the first time (01-core §11 item 5). The Free Cities have no binding name, so a water supply contract is a bundle of separate contracts between the Government and each city, sealed together at one contract meeting (01-core §5.2). Peace terms become contract clauses: the Government binds by annex, the Free Cities by contract sheets and pledges, the Arc by the Hierophant's word. The default truce is 60 turns (five years) (09 §3.7, provisional T29-14).

## 7.3 Faction Relations and Enemy Control

Seoul fact: EnemyControl at https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/GAME/Assets/Janseon/Core/CampaignTurnDomain.cs#L224-L226 is a faction inequality and does not consume alliance or treaty semantics. https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/GAME/Assets/Janseon/Core/SettlementDomain.cs#L448 does not change the POC control graph. This implementation boundary is not to be extended into a diplomatic law of the world or a policy of unconquerability.

v3 mapping (09 §5): the factions inside a faction are the OMO Party and the Claw Party in the Government, each single city in the Free Cities, and blood and iron (the name-worth of blood and part count) in the Arc. There is nobody above the Free Cities; when something must be decided together, a contract meeting is called each time, and what is agreed there binds only the cities that set their seals to it (01-core §7.2).

## 7.1 협상·거래

서울 사실: SP-1.0.0의 제안→자격→수락→예약→실행→영수증 순서를 유지한다. 관계나 지휘권을 거래 수락만으로 자동 취득하지 않는다. CK3 참조: depth-01-social-intrigue.md:15-43은 발송자 흥미·수신자 수용·유효성·사후 효과를 별도로 정의한다. 모든 상호작용을 단일 확률 굴림으로 환산하지 않는다. 제품 권한: 협상 선택지·가격·수용 산식은 제도 미정이다.

v3 세계 기준: 서울 전체가 쓰는 돈이 없으므로 거래는 양쪽의 셈을 맞추는 일이다. 정부는 끼와 근무일, 자유도시들은 킬로와 손시간, 아크는 하루 충전과 정비 차례로 센다(03장 11절). 정부의 끼 증표는 장부 안에서만 쓰고, 장부 밖 사람에게 넘기는 것은 법으로 금한다.

## 7.2 강화·계약

CK3 참조: mechanics-06-vassals-court-council.md:11-95의 단계별 의무와 정부형별 계약 구조는 참조다. 제품 권한: 서울 동맹·조약·휴전·정복·소유권 이전 정책 전부는 제도 미정이다. 전쟁 개시 임계 제안을 승인 법제로 쓰지 않는다.

v3 세계 기준: 세 세력 사이의 큰 약속은 급수계약이다. 30년 주기로 1차 2066년, 2차 2096년이었고 3차는 개막인 2126년이며 3차에 아크가 처음 앉는다(01-core 11절 5항). 자유도시들에는 묶는 이름이 없으므로 급수계약도 정부와 각 도시 사이의 따로 된 계약 묶음이고, 한 계약회에서 함께 도장을 찍는다(01-core 5.2절). 평화 조건은 계약의 조항이 된다. 정부는 부속서, 자유도시들은 계약서 장과 맡김, 아크는 교주의 말로 맺는다. 휴전 기본값은 60턴(5년)이다(09장 3.7절, 잠정 T29-14).

## 7.3 파벌 관계와 적 통제

서울 사실: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/GAME/Assets/Janseon/Core/CampaignTurnDomain.cs#L224-L226 의 EnemyControl은 파벌 불평등이며 동맹·조약 의미를 소비하지 않는다. https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/GAME/Assets/Janseon/Core/SettlementDomain.cs#L448 은 POC 통제 그래프를 변경하지 않는다. 이 구현 경계를 세계의 외교 법칙이나 정복 불가 정책으로 확대하지 않는다.

v3 대응(09장 5절): 세력 안의 파벌은 정부의 OMO당과 클로당, 자유도시들의 도시 하나하나, 아크의 피와 쇠(핏줄의 이름값과 부위 수)다. 자유도시 도시들 위에는 아무도 없고, 함께 정할 일이 생기면 그때마다 계약회를 연다. 계약회에서 맺은 것은 도장 찍은 도시만 묶는다(01-core 7.2절).

# CH4 Economy and Logistics

This chapter separates Seoul facts, CK3 references, and product authority. The institutions and numbers of the reference game are not promoted to Seoul rules. An approved contract does not mean implementation is complete, and the replacement scope of SP-1.0.0 takes precedence over past shared-world clauses.

External product source: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/tree/main (measured revision 3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53; citations use fixed-revision URLs). The CK3 evidence files are survey receipts from 2026-10-27 and are not build inputs. The integrity of that installation is unverified. Source paths and identifiers are survey notations and are not game UI display names.

[Parent Contract: Detailed Single-Player Design](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 4.1 Labor, Population, Employment, and Rations

Seoul fact: Maintains the labor eligibility, reservation, individual preservation, and ration arrival/closing order of the approved SP-1.0.0 and the economy and logistics clauses. Persons, equipment, and labor are not automatically replaced by a single resource number. Product authority: New labor efficiency, wages, consumption amounts, and closing intervals are undecided in the system, and exceptions to existing approved clauses are not added arbitrarily.

v3 world basis: there is no money used across all of Seoul. The Government counts in meals and workdays, the Free Cities in kilos and hand-hours, the Arc in day-charges and maintenance turns. The design yardstick that puts the three reckonings in one table is the person-day (the meals and 10 L of water one person needs to live a day on the platform level), and the person-day is not money inside the world (03 §11). Rations are handed out by the Government against ledger coupons, moved by the Free Cities through contracts and markets, and shared out in the Arc by the Near Houses and each station's Bench Keeper (01-core §5.3).

## 4.2 Production, Construction, and Resources

Seoul fact: Follows authored data → validated immutable catalog → Core consumption at https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/AGENTS.md#L67-L71. GAME/Assets/Janseon/Data/Authoring/BattleSetupDefinition.cs:10-25 and Data/Validation/GameDataCatalogValidator.cs:30-32 are code examples of rule versions and rule-drift validation. CK3 reference: The separation of cost calculation and the building-completion hook in mechanics-05-economy.md:54-98 are authoring conventions. CK3 building costs are not copied as Seoul prices.

v3 world basis: the building slots of a holding are the station's facilities (heat pumps, wells, fans, fibre-sugar vats, light fields, wind frames, water wheels, maintenance benches), and their cost includes parts and the hands of skilled workers. A technology lives only when parts, knowledge, and hands are all present (09 §4.1, 03 §3).

## 4.3 Assets, Debt, Inheritance, and Handover

Seoul fact: A settlement is property, not a new title (https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/GAME/Assets/Janseon/Foundation/Presentation/SeoulCampaignSession.cs#L68). Asset use and handover are read within the SP-1.0.0 boundary of eligibility → reservation → execution → receipt. CK3 reference: mechanics-05-economy.md:100-156 shows the separation of holding types from the ingredients of modifiers, control, and development. The actual monthly settlement order and rounding are not exposed. Product authority: The policy for expanding Seoul debt, inheritance, and production figures is undecided in the system.

## 4.4 Logistics, Isolation, and Overextension

Seoul fact: The shared scale of supply, isolation, and overextension in the existing warfare-and-sieges is referenced with design assumptions distinguished from approved parts. Unit size follows the variable capacity and personnel preservation of Decision 15. CK3 reference: The control interpolation and growth ingredients in mechanics-05-economy.md:118-153 are merely examples of curve structure and are not Seoul tax rates or overextension penalties. Product authority: Transport throughput, isolation losses, baseline periods, and production costs are all undecided in the system except for approved authored values.

v3 world basis: the supply limit is the heat, air, and water limits of the stations along the route (01-core §4.1). A surface march is worn down by cold and a deep-tunnel march by air (09 §3.13). There is no oil, and loads move by rail (03 §7). The scarce inputs handed to the battlefield are the six `ammo`, `cells`, `implants`, `fuel`, `parts`, and `medicine`; the Government runs short of `ammo` and `fuel` first, the Free Cities of `cells` and `parts`, the Arc of `implants` and `medicine` (09 §5).

[Product Decision Ledger — Undecided Items Are Owner Authority](/gdd/design/open-decisions/)

[Korean Orthography and Naming Rules](/gdd/design/korean-terminology-and-naming/)

## Ownership of Preservation Contracts and Decision Numbers

Product Decisions 13 (individual-check combat), 14 (time-based strategic movement), and 15 (variable quota) are owner decisions preserved in the approved rules documents below. They are in a different namespace from the mechanism D13/D14/D15 sheet numbers and do not approve the proposal sheet. SP-1.0.0 replaces the shared-world, participant, host, occupancy, and online-proxy clauses with historical scope, and maintains the contracts for actual movement, on-site participation, authority, single settlement, and save errors. pw-01 is a war-initiation threshold proposal, not an approved product decision number.

[Approval Ledger for Decisions 14 and 15 and Hero Classes](/gdd/rules/hero-squads-and-time-based-movement/)

[Decisions 13 and 15 and Responsibility for Individual, Situational, and Aggregate Calculation](/gdd/rules/personal-resolution-battle/)

[Labor, Reservation, Ration Arrival/Closing, and Handover Preservation Clauses](/gdd/rules/rules-economy-logistics-clauses/)

# CH4 경제·물류

이 장은 서울 사실·CK3 참조·제품 권한을 분리한다. 참조 게임의 제도·수치를 서울 규칙으로 승격하지 않는다. 승인 계약은 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않으며 SP-1.0.0의 대체 범위가 과거 공유 세계 조항보다 우선한다.

외부 제품 원천: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/tree/main (측정 revision 3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53; 인용은 고정 revision URL 사용). CK3 증거 파일은 2026-10-27 조사 영수증이며 빌드 입력이 아니다. 해당 설치본의 무결성은 미검증이다. 출처 경로와 식별자는 조사 표기이며 게임 UI 표시명이 아니다.

[상위 계약: 싱글플레이 상세 기획](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 4.1 노동·인구·고용·배급

서울 사실: 승인 SP-1.0.0과 경제·물류 조항의 노동 자격·예약·개인 보존·배급 도착/마감 순서를 유지한다. 인물·장비·노동을 자원 한 숫자로 자동 대체하지 않는다. 제품 권한: 새 노동 효율·급여·소비량·마감 간격은 제도 미정이며 기존 승인 조항의 예외를 임의 추가하지 않는다.

v3 세계 기준: 서울 전체가 쓰는 돈은 없다. 정부는 끼와 근무일, 자유도시들은 킬로와 손시간, 아크는 하루 충전과 정비 차례로 센다. 세 셈을 한 표에 놓는 설계 잣대는 사람날(사람 하나가 승강장 층에서 하루를 사는 데 드는 끼니와 물 10 L)이고, 사람날은 세계 안의 돈이 아니다(03장 11절). 배급은 정부가 장부 증표로, 자유도시들이 계약과 장터로 나누고, 아크에서는 곁집과 역의 정비장이 나눈다(01-core 5.3절).

## 4.2 생산·건설·자원

서울 사실: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/AGENTS.md#L67-L71 의 저작 데이터→검증된 불변 카탈로그→Core 소비를 따른다. GAME/Assets/Janseon/Data/Authoring/BattleSetupDefinition.cs:10-25와 Data/Validation/GameDataCatalogValidator.cs:30-32는 규칙 판본과 rule-drift 검증의 코드 사례다. CK3 참조: mechanics-05-economy.md:54-98의 비용 계산 분리·건물 완료 훅은 저작 관례다. CK3 건물 비용을 서울 가격으로 복사하지 않는다.

v3 세계 기준: 영지의 건물 자리는 역의 시설(열 펌프, 우물, 팬, 섬유당 통, 빛밭, 바람틀, 수차, 정비대)이고, 시설의 비용에는 부품과 기술자의 손이 든다. 기술은 부품, 지식, 손 셋이 모두 있어야 산다(09장 4.1절, 03장 3절).

## 4.3 자산·채무·상속·인도

서울 사실: 정착지는 재산이지 신규 작위가 아니다(https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/GAME/Assets/Janseon/Foundation/Presentation/SeoulCampaignSession.cs#L68). 자산 사용·인도는 SP-1.0.0의 자격→예약→실행→영수증 경계로 읽는다. CK3 참조: mechanics-05-economy.md:100-156은 보유 유형과 수정자·통제·발전도 재료의 분리를 보인다. 실제 월 정산 순서·반올림은 미노출이다. 제품 권한: 서울 채무·상속·생산 수치의 확장 정책은 제도 미정이다.

## 4.4 물류·고립·과확장

서울 사실: 기존 warfare-and-sieges의 보급·고립·과확장 공유 척도는 설계 가정과 승인 부분을 구분하여 참조한다. 부대 규모는 결정 15의 가변 정원과 인원 보존을 따른다. CK3 참조: mechanics-05-economy.md:118-153의 통제 보간과 성장 재료는 곡선 구조 사례일 뿐 서울 세율·과확장 벌칙이 아니다. 제품 권한: 수송 처리량·고립 손실·기준 기간·제작비 전부는 승인된 저작값 외 제도 미정이다.

v3 세계 기준: 보급의 한도는 경로 위 역의 열·공기·물 한도다(01-core 4.1절). 지상 행군은 추위로, 깊은 터널 행군은 공기로 소모된다(09장 3.13절). 기름은 없고 짐은 레일로 나른다(03장 7절). 전장에 넘기는 결핍 투입물은 `ammo`, `cells`, `implants`, `fuel`, `parts`, `medicine` 여섯이며, 정부는 `ammo`와 `fuel`, 자유도시들은 `cells`와 `parts`, 아크는 `implants`와 `medicine`이 먼저 모자란다(09장 5절).

[제품 결정 원장 — 미결정은 소유자 권한](/gdd/design/open-decisions/)

[한국어 표기와 명명 규칙](/gdd/design/korean-terminology-and-naming/)

## 보존 계약과 결정 번호의 소유

제품 결정 13(개인 판정 전투)·14(시간 기반 전략 이동)·15(가변 정원)은 아래 승인 규칙 문서에 보존된 소유자 결정이다. 메커니즘 D13/D14/D15 시트 번호와 다른 이름공간이며 제안 시트를 승인하지 않는다. SP-1.0.0은 공유 세계·참가자·호스트·점유·온라인 대행 조항을 역사 범위로 대체하고 실제 이동·현장 참가·권한·단일 정산·저장 오류 계약을 유지한다. pw-01은 전쟁 개시 임계 제안이지 승인된 제품 결정 번호가 아니다.

[결정 14·15 및 영웅 클래스 승인 원장](/gdd/rules/hero-squads-and-time-based-movement/)

[결정 13·15 및 개인·상황·집계 계산 책임](/gdd/rules/personal-resolution-battle/)

# CH8 Faith, Culture, and Knowledge

This chapter separates Seoul facts, CK3 references, and product authority. The institutions and numbers of the reference game are not promoted to Seoul rules. An approved contract does not mean implementation is complete, and the replacement scope of SP-1.0.0 takes precedence over past shared-world clauses.

External product source: https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/tree/main (measured revision 3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53; citations use fixed-revision URLs). The CK3 evidence files are survey receipts from 2026-10-27 and are not build inputs. The integrity of that installation is unverified. Source paths and identifiers are survey notations and are not game UI display names.

[Parent Contract: Detailed Single-Player Design](/gdd/system-design/singleplayer-design-sp-1-0-0/)

## 8.1 Existence Boundary of the Faith System

Seoul fact: The product is a character-centered grand strategy 4X RPG set in post-collapse Seoul (https://github.com/islee23520/seoul-dengoku/blob/3e3c03349eafaaf88347d119a4bdd0c6d44abc53/AGENTS.md#L54). The canonical world is owned by LORE/WIKI and does not declare religious grand strategy as a default feature. CK3 reference: The doctrines, choice eligibility, modifiers, and rituals in mechanics-08-faith-culture.md:11-125 are the structure of that installed version. Product authority: the game effects and values of the faith system are undecided. That a faith exists, and how it is built, is the v3 world fact below.

v3 world basis: there is one organised faith, the Arc, and it replaced every earlier religion (bible §1 row 9). Believers replace parts of the body with machines, and that is baptism. In the Arc, faith is counted by the number of implanted parts. Go Ye-jin is the Messiah and the Hierophant; her rulings are never written down and become law as people repeat them. When a believer dies, the brain is sealed and placed in the sanctuary (01-core §7.3). CK3 mapping (09 §4.4): the place of conversion is baptism, paid for in implant parts, maintenance turns, and power. The place of piety is the giving. The Government and the Free Cities have no organised faith, and the Government's national rites are rites, not a faith currency (09 §4.2).

## 8.2 Culture and Community

CK3 reference: The culture composition, acceptance, fusion, and conversion in mechanics-08-faith-culture.md:127-218 are structural references, and ethnic/regional names or acceptance values are not automatically assigned to Seoul's political organizations. Product authority: The in-game state representation of culture and community and the relationship adjustment and conversion policies are undecided in the system.

v3 world basis: culture divides along the voices of the three polities: the Government speaks in Republic of Korea official prose hardened by scarcity, the Free Cities in workshop talk, the Arc in the words of the body and of repair (01-core §2.2). The Arc splitting off from the Free Cities is the real example of a cultural split, and Free City workshop talk still lingers at Arc maintenance benches (09 §4.4). Descendants of pre-Blackout immigrant communities have no separate political space; they are ordinary households living at the stations of each polity (01-core §10).

## 8.3 Knowledge, Education, Technology, and Restoration

Seoul fact: Refers to the body, technology, and daily execution of the approved SP-1.0.0 and maintains the proposed status of D14. CK3 reference: The era eligibility, innovation probability, and progress accumulation in mechanics-08-faith-culture.md:129-207 are separate ingredients. These are not adopted as Seoul's monthly technology research. Product authority: Education, technology diffusion, facility restoration costs, success rates, and time are all undecided in the system except for approved data.

v3 world basis: a technology stays alive only when parts, knowledge, and hands are all present (03 §3). The places of education are Government schools, Free City workbench apprenticeships (from age twelve), and Arc maintenance benches (09 §4.1). Hands are passed down through households, workbenches, and benches, and what each generation loses is set by 03 §10.
